description: How each ACP agent preset is launched before its binary is looked up: opencode with acp, the Claude and Codex bridges with npx -y and their package (no version pin), and a custom command split on spaces with empty pieces dropped (no quoting). The platform finds opencode and npx on its own install paths; a custom executable is used as typed. An unknown agent, or a custom command with no pieces, has no command.
function: ACPAdapter.agentCommand(for:) before the install-path lookup ↔ powerup_core::harness::acp::agents::agent_launch — input {agent, customCommand}; expected {program: "opencode" | "npx" | {"command": <executable>}, arguments: [string]}, or null when there is no command
verifiedBy: Swift: ACPFixtureTests.testAcpAgentLaunchTable runs ACPAdapter.agentCommand(for:isExecutable:) with every install path executable; the launch comes from the core through the bridge. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/acp.rs acp_agent_launch_cases runs harness::acp::agents::agent_launch.
capturedAgainst: ACPAdapter.swift's agentCommand(for:) as of dddf9c6 (Swift 5.9.2, macOS 27.2), with the install-path probe stubbed

cases.name: opencode runs acp
cases.reason: HK-129: opencode speaks ACP natively with its acp subcommand; the custom command is ignored.

cases.name: the Claude bridge runs through npx
cases.reason: HK-129: npx -y with no version pin, so the bridge floats with npm; its package name was last verified on 2026-08-27 (claude-agent-acp 0.16.2).

cases.name: the Codex bridge runs through npx
cases.reason: HK-129: npx -y with no version pin; handshake verified live on 2026-08-27 (codex-acp 1.7.0).

cases.name: a custom command splits on spaces
cases.reason: HK-130: the first piece is the executable, the rest its arguments.

cases.name: double spaces make no empty argument
leading and trailing spaces are dropped
cases.reason: HK-130: empty pieces are dropped at both ends.

cases.name: a one-word command has no arguments
a command of spaces is no command
cases.reason: HK-130: an empty result means no command (start then says none is configured).

cases.name: an empty command is no command
cases.reason: HK-130: an empty result means no command.

cases.name: a tab is not a separator
cases.reason: HK-130: only the space character splits; a tab stays inside its piece.

cases.name: a tab-only command is a command
cases.reason: HK-130: a tab is not a space, so it is a piece of its own.

cases.name: a space with a combining mark is not a separator
cases.reason: HK-063, HK-130: Swift splits on Characters equal to a space; a space that a combining acute follows is one other Character.

cases.name: a path with a space splits
cases.reason: HK-130: there is no quoting, so a path with a space splits wrongly (kept from Swift).

cases.name: agent names are case-sensitive
cases.reason: The stored agent must match exactly; Custom is unknown.

cases.name: an unknown agent has no command
cases.reason: An agent this build does not know resolves to nothing.

cases.name: an empty agent has no command
